q1.explanationZh: invest 既可作及物动词“投入（时间、金钱、精力）”，也可作不及物动词“投资”，常用 invest in。

q3.explanationZh: invest 加 -ment 构成名词 investment“投资”。

q4.explanationZh: visible“看得见的”加否定前缀 in- 构成 invisible“看不见的”。

q5.explanationZh: 动词 invite 去 e 加 -ation 构成名词 invitation“邀请”。

q6.explanationZh: invite 及物动词“邀请”，常用 invite sb. to (do) sth.。

q7.explanationZh: invite 的 -ing 形式 inviting 作形容词，意为“吸引人的；诱人的”。

q8.explanationZh: involve“牵涉；包含”，常用 be involved in sth.“参与某事”。

q9.explanationZh: iron 名词“铁；熨斗”，动词“熨烫”。

q10.explanationZh: regular“规则的”前加否定前缀 ir- 构成 irregular“不规则的”。

q12.explanationZh: island“岛”，注意 s 不发音。

q13.explanationZh: isolate 及物动词“使隔离”，常用 isolate ... from ...。

q14.explanationZh: isolate 的过去分词 isolated 作形容词，意为“偏远的；孤独的”。

q15.explanationZh: issue 名词“问题；发行；（书刊的）期”，动词“发行；颁布”。

q17.explanationZh: item“项目；（新闻的）一条”，如 an item of news。

q18.explanationZh: its 是 it 的所有格“它的”，不要和 it’s（= it is）混淆。

q19.explanationZh: it 的反身代词是 itself“它自己”。

q21.explanationZh: jail 名词“监狱”，动词“监禁”，be jailed for ... years“被判……年监禁”。

q22.explanationZh: jam 动词“塞满；堵塞”，名词“阻塞”，traffic jam“交通堵塞”。

q24.explanationZh: jaw“颌，下巴”，复数 jaws 可指“嘴”。

q25.explanationZh: jazz“爵士乐”，结尾是两个 z。

q26.explanationZh: jealous“妒忌的”，常用 be jealous of sb./sth.；名词是 jealousy。

q27.explanationZh: jeans“牛仔裤”，总是用复数形式。

q28.explanationZh: jeep“吉普车”，中间是两个 e。

q29.explanationZh: jelly“果冻；胶状物”，注意双写 l。

q30.explanationZh: jet 名词“喷气式飞机；喷射”，也可作形容词“喷气式的”。

q32.explanationZh: jewelry“珠宝”（总称，不可数），英式拼写为 jewellery。

q33.explanationZh: job“工作”，是可数名词，find a job“找到工作”。

q34.explanationZh: jog“慢跑”，第三人称单数 jogs，-ing 形式双写 g：jogging。

q35.explanationZh: join“参加，加入（组织或团体）”，join in 指参加活动。

q36.explanationZh: joint 名词“关节；接合处”，形容词“共同的”。

q37.explanationZh: “邀请某人（去/做）……”= invite sb. to，to 后接名词或动词原形。

q38.explanationZh: involve sb. in sth.“使某人卷入某事”，介词用 in。

q39.explanationZh: “卷入，参与”= be/become/get involved in sth.，用过去分词 involved。

q40.explanationZh: isolate ... from ...“把……与……隔开”，介词用 from。

q41.explanationZh: at issue“在争论中的；有分歧的”，介词用 at。

q42.explanationZh: issue sb. with sth.“把某物发给某人”，介词用 with。

accept: be jealous of somebody else’s success
be jealous of somebody else's success

q43.explanationZh: be jealous of ...“嫉妒……”，介词用 of。

q44.explanationZh: find a job as ...“找到一份当……的工作”，as 表示“作为”。

q45.explanationZh: join in“参加（活动）”，强调和别人一起做某事。

q46.explanationZh: “指关节”= finger joints，joint 意为“关节”，手指关节不止一个，用复数。

q47.explanationZh: joint 作形容词“共同的”，joint effort“共同的努力”。

q48.explanationZh: invest sth. in ...“把……投资于……”，介词用 in。

accept: Strike while the iron is hot.
Strike while the iron is hot

q49.explanationZh: 谚语 Strike while the iron is hot.“趁热打铁”，iron 意为“铁”。

q50.explanationZh: issue 作动词“发行；颁布”，“被发行”用被动语态 be issued。

q51.explanationZh: jam sth. into ...“把某物塞进……”，介词用 into。

q52.explanationZh: 警察“调查”车祸原因，用 investigate；叙述已发生的事，用过去式 investigated。

q53.explanationZh: be made of 后接材料，“不锈钢”可以说 stainless iron/steel，此处首字母 i，填 iron。

q54.explanationZh: its 后需要名词，“小说发行”用 issue 作名词“发行”。

q55.explanationZh: item 作名词“（新闻）一条”，本句是手册 item 词条的例句。

q56.explanationZh: Drip irrigation“滴灌”，作主语用名词 irrigation。

q57.explanationZh: be involved in“卷入”，is 后用过去分词 involved。

q58.explanationZh: 字母有大有小，说明字写得“不规则”，is 后用形容词 irregular。

q59.explanationZh: that 后接单数名词，能买、有颜色的衣服，填 jacket“夹克”。

q60.explanationZh: It is + adj. + of sb. to do sth. 评价人的行为；鼓励别人投资管理不善的公司是“不负责任的”，填 irresponsible。

q61.explanationZh: why not 后接动词原形；join sb. in (doing) sth.“和某人一起做某事”。

q62.sampleAnswer: The museum has become a more inviting place.
references: The museum has become a more inviting place.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “吸引人的”= inviting，作形容词修饰 place；“变得”用 has become，强调现在的结果。

q63.sampleAnswer: The engineer invested efforts into the development of chips, overcoming one challenge after another, which earned him the title of “Role Model of the Era”.
references: The engineer invested efforts into the development of chips, overcoming one challenge after another, which earned him the title of “Role Model of the Era”.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “倾注心血于……”= invest efforts into ...；“不断攻坚克难”用现在分词短语 overcoming one challenge after another 作伴随状语；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。

q64.sampleAnswer: I’m sure there will be fewer traffic jams in the future.
references: I’m sure there will be fewer traffic jams in the future.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “交通堵塞”= traffic jam，可数名词；“鲜有发生”可以说 there will be fewer traffic jams。

q65.sampleAnswer: In spite of the difficulties, they went on with their task.
references: In spite of the difficulties, they went on with their task.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: in spite of“尽管”后接名词；“继续执行任务”= go on with their task。

q66.sampleAnswer: Such an unusual work of art attracts many visitors.
references: Such an unusual work of art attracts many visitors.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “非凡的”= unusual，元音音素开头前用 an：such an unusual ...；“艺术作品”= a work of art，work 此处可数。

q67.sampleAnswer: We started singing a folk song and soon many pupils joined in.
references: We started singing a folk song and soon many pupils joined in.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “加入进来（参加活动）”= join in；start doing“开始做”。

q68.sampleAnswer: A new law has been issued that the income tax rate will be further lowered.
references: A new law has been issued that the income tax rate will be further lowered.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “已经颁布”用现在完成时的被动语态 has been issued；that 引导同位语从句说明法令内容，因主语较短而后置。

q69.sampleAnswer: It is impolite to break in when other people are having a conversation.
references: It is impolite to break in when other people are having a conversation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: It is + adj. + to do sth. 句型，it 作形式主语；“插嘴”= break in；“不礼貌的”= impolite。

q70.sampleAnswer: The village is almost isolated from the outside world, and thus lots of local customs are well preserved there.
references: The village is almost isolated from the outside world, and thus lots of local customs are well preserved there.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “与世隔绝”= be isolated from the outside world；“得以保留”用被动语态 be well preserved。

q71.sampleAnswer: It is reported that over ninety percent of the countries in the world have joined that international organization.
references: It is reported that over ninety percent of the countries in the world have joined that international organization.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “据报道”= It is reported that ...；“参加组织”用 join；“国际的”= international。
